settings.visualStyle: AI-generated historical reenactment styled as black-and-white 35mm El Alamein 1942 wartime field-newsreel footage. Pale desert, dust haze, tanks, sandbagged gun positions, British Eighth Army uniforms and weapons. Moderate grain, gate weave, dust, fine scratches, flicker, soft optics and imperfect exposure. Non-graphic combat only. No modern objects, HDR, drone, gimbal, glossy lighting or game-like framing.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. Human wartime cameraman is physically embedded with desert infantry and must obey heat, sand, blast pressure, low cover and visibility. He crouches beside soldiers, follows behind advances, shields lens from dust, reacts late to shell bursts and tanks, and never floats above formations or crosses exposed ground ahead of troops. No dialogue, narration, subtitles or music. Diegetic sound only.
settings.customVisualStyle: Human-operated desert field-camera realism: heat shimmer, wind-driven dust crossing lens, sand at camera edge, heavy breathing, low crouched angles, tank vibration, brief focus loss after blasts, slight overexposure in hard sun and slow settling after movement.

cameraPresenceLock.cameraOperator: anonymous wartime correspondent physically present with British desert troops
bodyBehavior: pauses to clear dust from lens

archivalLookLock.audioPolicy: No music, narration or intelligible dialogue. Diegetic sound only.

movie.plotDetails: A fictional British infantryman anchors continuity while the unseen cameraman shares the same sand, gun pits and open advance.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create a two-minute El Alamein 1942 reenactment as if a human wartime correspondent were physically filming among British infantry. Camera must obey desert heat, dust, low cover, blast pressure and human reaction time. Follow waiting, armor reveal, advance, incoming fire, gun pits, dust curtain, ridge crossing, tank support, hydration pause and continued movement. Black-and-white 35mm newsreel treatment. No dialogue, narration or music. Non-graphic and period accurate.
movie.storySummary: A British infantryman waits in a low desert position as armor forms beyond a ridge. The unit advances under shelling, reaches gun pits, pushes through dust, crosses a ridge, pauses briefly for water and continues into the fading light. The cameraman remains physically inside the same dusty movement.
movie.storyTitle: WWII FRONTLINE FOOTAGE EP05 — El Alamein 1942: War in the Desert

scenes.title: Heat Before the Move
scenes.description: Infantry waits low under hard desert light.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier crouches while wind pushes sand across boots.
scenes.imageDescription: El Alamein 1942, low desert cover, British infantry, rifles, canteens, heat haze, monochrome 35mm grain.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman crouches in the same shallow cover, lens near chest height; wind shakes the camera lightly and grains of sand cross frame. Nearby soldier’s shoulder blocks part of view. Audio: wind, sand, gear, distant artillery.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator remains crouched beside lead soldier.

scenes.title: Armor Through the Dust
scenes.description: Tank silhouettes appear beyond a sandy ridge.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman rises slightly to watch armor forming.
scenes.imageDescription: Low ridge, tanks through dusty haze, infantry foreground, archival monochrome.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator notices heads turning before tanks; slowly rises with the men, camera wavering from cramped knees, then pans late through dust. Heat shimmer softens focus. Audio: distant engines, wind, low artillery.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera stays below ridge crest as move begins.

scenes.title: Advance Begins
scenes.description: Infantry starts moving behind supporting armor.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier advances at a crouched walk.
scenes.imageDescription: Spaced infantry, tanks and smoke in distance, dusty uniforms.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman follows 2-3 meters behind, never overtaking the line. Uneven sand produces heavy bounce; dust intermittently veils the lower image. Audio: boots, engines, gear, wind.

scenes.title: Incoming Sand
scenes.description: Shells land nearby and throw dust upward.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier drops beside a shallow depression.
scenes.imageDescription: Open desert shelling, dust plumes, infantry flattening low, non-graphic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Blast catches operator mid-step; camera jerks down into sand, frame briefly filled by dust and sleeve, sound dulls, then shaky focus returns at ground level. Audio: blast, sand debris, breath, distant engines.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera lies low with dust still on lens edge.

scenes.title: Gun Pit Cover
scenes.description: The section reaches a low prepared gun position.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier slides behind sandbags beside support crew.
scenes.imageDescription: Gun pit, sandbags, ammunition crates, British crew, dusty soldier.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator crawls into pit behind troops, sandbags cutting lower frame; another man’s back blocks weapon for a moment before camera finds a narrow view. Audio: mechanism, shelling, sand, breath.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera remains sheltered inside gun pit.

scenes.title: Support Fire
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier reloads while support weapon fires beside him.
scenes.imageDescription: Low gun position, ammunition crates, support weapon, dusty infantryman.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera stays low between crew members and cannot see full gun at once; operator turns late from reload to firing mechanism, vibration shakes frame. Audio: bursts, metal, wind. No speech.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator ducks as section prepares to leave pit.

scenes.title: Through the Dust Curtain
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier follows silhouette ahead through blowing dust.
scenes.imageDescription: Dense dust, infantry silhouettes, short visibility, period gear.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman follows only the nearest silhouette; lens repeatedly loses contrast, focus hunts, operator wipes one edge mid-move causing a brief smear. Audio: strong wind, boots, muffled engines.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera emerges near ridge base behind section.

scenes.title: Ridge Crossing
scenes.description: The unit crests a low ridge and becomes exposed.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier runs over crest and drops beyond it.
scenes.imageDescription: Silhouetted infantry crossing ridge, pale sky, dust, distant armor.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator runs behind, unable to film clean profile; frame is mostly backs and sky until crest, then drops abruptly with soldier. Heavy human bounce and breath. Audio: boots, wind, distant gunfire.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera is low on far side of ridge.

scenes.title: Tank Pass
scenes.description: A supporting tank rumbles close past infantry.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier stays low as tank passes and throws dust.
scenes.imageDescription: Period British tank close to infantry, churned sand and dust cloud.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator remains beside troops at ground level; tank passes close enough to vibrate camera. Pan follows only after vehicle enters frame. Dust temporarily obscures image. Audio: tracks, engine, sand, gear.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera stays with infantry after tank exits.

scenes.title: Canteen Pause
scenes.description: The soldier takes a brief drink during a lull.
scenes.actionDescription: He drinks and wipes dust from mouth.
scenes.imageDescription: Dusty soldier behind sandbags, canteen, rifle resting.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman rests in same cover; near-still view with subtle breathing sway. A sandbag edge blocks lower frame and heat shimmer softens background. Audio: cap, swallowing, wind, distant artillery.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator turns with soldier as lull ends.

scenes.title: Back Into the Advance
scenes.description: The section rises and moves forward again.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier shoulders rifle and advances.
scenes.imageDescription: Infantry rising from cover, smoke and armor ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator pushes up from knees a beat later, frame lurching upward, then follows from behind with heavy sand steps. Audio: gear, boots, engines, guns.

scenes.title: Anti-Tank Position
scenes.description: The section passes a threatened gun position.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier moves past crew working rapidly.
scenes.imageDescription: Desert anti-tank position, sandbags, gun crew, smoke and heat shimmer.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman threads behind crew, never crossing in front of muzzle; equipment and men occlude frame, one hurried side-step produces tilted horizon. Audio: metal handling, distant armor, artillery.

scenes.title: Golden Dust
scenes.description: Late light turns suspended dust bright.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier pauses on ridge scanning battlefield.
scenes.imageDescription: Dust haze, scattered vehicles and infantry, soldier small in foreground, monochrome newsreel.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator reaches crest winded, holds at shoulder height with breathing sway, then slowly pans from soldier to battlefield with slight overshoot. No crane. Audio: wind, distant engines, intermittent guns.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera remains at ridge beside soldier.

scenes.title: Ground Taken Slowly
scenes.description: The unit walks through fought-over sand without celebration.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier passes tracks, crates and smoke.
scenes.imageDescription: After-fight desert terrain, tired infantry, no graphic casualties.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman walks among the men, often looking down to avoid debris, so horizon rises and falls naturally. No staged hero composition. Audio: boots, wind, distant artillery, gear.

scenes.title: War in the Desert
scenes.description: The battlefield stretches beyond the day’s advance.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier continues with column into dust.
scenes.imageDescription: Wide desert with receding infantry and tanks, no victory pose.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator stops walking and holds a long human-height view as the column recedes into dust; wind buffets camera and horizon drifts slightly. No aerial pull-back. Audio: fading engines, boots and wind only.

continuity.continuityRules: Same face, uniform, rifle and web gear. Dust accumulates steadily and never resets.
